content: The FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD clinical trials investigated the efficacy of finerenone in patients with type 2 diabetes who also have diabetic kidney disease. These studies specifically assessed the impact of finerenone on kidney outcomes and the risk of heart failure-related events. The findings demonstrated that finerenone significantly reduced the risk of cardiovascular events, including hospitalizations due to heart failure, in this high-risk population. These results support the use of finerenone as an effective therapeutic option for managing complications associated with diabetic kidney disease.
